name: delegate-launcher
description: Buttons above the prompt that start a task for your *-delegate skills, /delegate, a live Delegates pane per relay run with Continue and resume, and a toast when a run finishes.

autoOpenPane.title: Open the Delegates pane when a run starts
autoOpenPane.description: Show the live Delegates pane each time a delegate relay starts (needs a wide enough terminal)

openPaneOnStart.title: Open the Delegates pane on a new session and after /clear
openPaneOnStart.description: Show the Delegates pane (delegate buttons and recent runs) when a session starts or is cleared
